verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents account sign-in instead of API keys: you can log in with GitHub to use a Copilot account, or with OpenAI to use a ChatGPT Plus/Pro account. Separately, a community member reports that OpenCode Zen almost always offers a FREE coding model. However, the documented sign-in paths use existing (often paid) subscriptions, and no evidence shows a free tier reached through a personal-account login. Missing for 10: documented free-tier access via personal account sign-in, first-party confirmation of free Zen models and how to access them, hands-on corroboration of a key-free onboarding flow.
